name: PdfCraft v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Make a missing external oracle loud instead of a silent pass by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2266
* One way to write a synthetic PDF fixture by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2275
* Measure rendering against Poppler, and turn the pixel test on by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2286
* Say what the render-oracle score does and does not mean by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2290
* Pin that every JBIG2 conformance fixture decodes to the same picture by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2300
* The fonts README still called the standard-14 widths an estimate by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2304
* The text oracle scored us zero for honouring a no-copy document by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2312
* Fix oracle Clippy failure for four-byte pixel chunks by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2342
* Preserve precision when writing page transforms by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/946
* Printing: a layer that is off in the document stays off on the sheets by @Byxis in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1135
* Clear image leftovers by @not-a-feature in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1151
* Tests: use 300 DPI synthetic scan for OCR searchability by @earlvanze in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1197
* M8: Bound and reuse repeated redaction overlays by @LabDennis in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1426
* M4: keep the last saved revision across undo (#1310, #1311, #1312) by @bartalos86 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1435
* M5: add comment and reply submission shortcuts by @Luchsen in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1457
* M12: mark leaf tags as artifacts by @earlvanze in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1475
* COS: index cross-reference entries on demand by @cyfung1031 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1505
* feat(ui): drop files on the Pages panel to insert pages by @tylerstoltz in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1547
* Clamp extracted Indexed image samples to the declared palette range by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1581
* Keep page labels and focused navigation consistent across reloads by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1667
* Keep the full final spread reachable with unequal page heights by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1672
* Text selection: dragging to the top or bottom edge of the view scrolls it by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1675
* Edit text & images: a dragged image's pixels follow its frame instead of waiting for the release by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1677
* Text selection: a drag after a double- or triple-click extends by whole words or lines by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1689
* fix(render, ui): form-heavy documents draw and fill fast (spot-colour images, widget placement, Fields panel) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1691
* i18n(pt-br): fix 6 Brazilian Portuguese strings by @s17sh70x2jfl031ag in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1694
* Sinhala and Tamil interface: draw with an installed font (part of #1688) by @manchitmr in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1706
* M5: Fill & Sign text reads across on rotated pages by @alexanderalber in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1710
* M14: add Vietnamese interface and date localization by @duydev in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1712
* Edit text: the four-way arrow wherever a drag moves, and a sharp page while editing by @ch0kemeister in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1717
* macOS: the standard About panel shows the website and Discord links (#1287) by @ch0kemeister in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1718
* M6: detect form fields on scanned pages (#1721) by @alexanderalber in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1722
* M2: Make literal text search linear and tolerate missing layout metadata by @LabDennis in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1725
* fix(ui): clicking a theme card in Preferences picks that theme by @umesh429 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1727
* Issue #1676: put fallback faces on the interface baseline by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1743
* M7: fold repeated image transforms into one cm instead of nesting q by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1746
* i18n: Taiwan vocabulary and the missing entries in zh-hant by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1750
* M7: keep the source operators of rows a text edit doesn't reach by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1754
* M7: draw new characters with the source font's own embedded program by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1760
* Automation: tell a tool name or an unknown id from a command without a tool in command_run by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1765
* M7: reuse a page's font resource and program when embedding again by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1779
* M2: Add word and character counts with optional content exclusions by @LabDennis in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1780
* M7: read the page once per keystroke when measuring a text draft by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1781
* M11: merge image fragments, and the Standard and Mobile optimizer presets (closes #1783) by @magdale76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1784
* M7: rewrap Chinese and Japanese text between characters by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1827
* M7: justify paragraphs whose font shows the space with another code by @komo1iddin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1832
* Edit image: give each flip button the icon of its own mirror axis by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1841
* M10: A6 paper in the print dialog and doc_print by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1849
* M7: Add / Update / Remove menu on Header and footer, Watermark, Background by @Byxis in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1857
* fix(a11y): mark_decorative no longer panics on an unpaired ParentTree key (#1809) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1862
* M2: a /Rotate that isn't a quarter turn counts as 0, as the page is drawn by @pauliusiv123-rgb in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1863
* fix(cos): a nonpositive crypt-filter /Length no longer overflows (#1816) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1864
* fix(audit): find rectangle covers closed with h or painted with b/b* (#1817) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1865
* fix(sign): an unreadable extendedKeyUsage allows no purpose (#1807) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1866
* audit: harden finding classes with golden tests and docs by @ejbarraza in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1892
* fix(audit): an applied redaction at the end of a line is not a faux redaction by @CouchRiv in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1898
* fix(a11y): bookmarks from structure keep the words of glyph-by-glyph headings by @CouchRiv in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1899
* fix(audit): report faux-redaction rectangles in top-left page points by @CouchRiv in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1900
* fix: render CCITT Group 4 images that declare /Rows 0 by @ehinderer in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1903
* fix(automation): a missing path under --root says where it was looked for (#1890) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1907
* M3: touchpad swipes glide on after the fingers lift on Wayland (#531) by @mlkonrad in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1909
* fix(redact): the tail of a longer number is not a phone number (#1884) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1911
* fix(forms): new text and date fields take Acrobat's Auto font size (#1888) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1912
* feat(ui): a middle click closes a tab (#1853) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1920
* fix(organize): bound how deep an import follows the object graph (#1800) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1921
* M2: Bound page-tree traversal memory for repeated children (#1798) by @LabDennis in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1926
* Compare files: side by side, scrolled and zoomed together by @regendorf-ux in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1927
* M11: measure every use of an image drawn through deeply nested forms (#1811) by @mlkonrad in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1933
* fix(edit): flattening keeps a widget it cannot draw and an undrawn reply (#1794) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1934
* fix(control): a deadline and a cap for connections that have not authenticated (#1806) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1939
* Issue #305: an update keeps the File Explorer menu choices, and the image menu gets a switch by @jcl-bit in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1941
* fix(sign): a signed revision of a password-protected file opens with the document's key (#1808) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1945
* feat(organize): Insert pages from file brings the file's bookmarks by @CouchRiv in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1947
* XFA: flatten a form into a plain PDF, or convert it to a static form by @ysrdevs in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1948
* feat(cli): page lists take ranges, and a missing page is named as typed (#1923) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1950
* M9: signature labels follow the interface language, and one the font can't draw is refused, never written as ? by @kekeandzeyu in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1951
* Keep native open replies queued while dialogs and pickers are active by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1953

* M6: auto-size text fields shrink and wrap typed text on screen, as on the page by @dsskaggs-ai in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1964
* Print: print as image (Advanced), with grayscale pictures by @regendorf-ux in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1965
* fix(automation): no top-level oneOf in form_set_props input schema (#1961) by @andreero0 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1967

* View: show page size when hovering the bottom-left of the page view (#1855) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1979

* M4: set page transitions and display times (/Trans, /Dur) through the engine and the tools by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2083
